mentions.name: devlens.io
mentions.description: An open-source tool that automatically maps a codebase's dependencies and posts precise structural insights directly into GitHub PRs, providing hard context without hallucinations. An MCP/CLI counterpart is planned so graphical context and summaries can be supplied to LLMs and agents via MCP integration.
mentions.problem: Code reviews and LLM/agent workflows lack precise structural codebase context, leading to hallucinations.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on devlens.io , It automatically maps your codebase dependencies and drops precise structural insights directly into your GitHub PRs. No hallucinations, just hard context.
